purpose: Create a clean GitHub label, milestone, board, and routing taxonomy before opening the private backend backlog.

labelCatalog.description: Repository shell, docs, env examples, and workspace wiring.

labelCatalog.name: type:api
labelCatalog.description: Server, routes, controllers, services, validators, and contracts.

labelCatalog.name: type:security
labelCatalog.description: Request ids, safe errors, tenant scope, access decisions, redaction, and denial proof.

labelCatalog.name: type:data

labelCatalog.name: type:audit
labelCatalog.description: Audit context, event writer, retention, exports, and evidence files.

labelCatalog.name: type:billing
labelCatalog.description: USD plans, test-mode checkout, invoices, webhooks, seat sync, and access locks.

labelCatalog.name: type:import

labelCatalog.name: type:ci

labelCatalog.name: priority:p0
labelCatalog.description: Required before the first backend alpha can be trusted.

labelCatalog.name: priority:p1
labelCatalog.description: Required before staging can accept pilot rehearsal data.

labelCatalog.name: area:repo-shell
labelCatalog.description: Root files, workspace setup, README, env examples, docs, and PR template.

labelCatalog.name: area:api-shell
labelCatalog.description: Express app shell, health route, route registry, and route envelope proof.

labelCatalog.name: area:tenant-access
labelCatalog.description: Tenant isolation, section permissions, membership admin guard, and denial proof.

labelCatalog.name: area:commercial-vault
labelCatalog.description: Value, agreement, LOA, negotiation, forecast, invoice, and redaction boundaries.

labelCatalog.name: area:importer
labelCatalog.description: Workbook staging, dry-run validation, quarantine, duplicate decisions, and rollback.

labelCatalog.name: area:billing
labelCatalog.description: USD plans, checkout preview, invoice lifecycle, webhooks, seat sync, and access lock.

labelCatalog.name: area:audit
labelCatalog.description: Request id, audit envelope, allowed/denied events, retention, and export proof.

labelCatalog.name: area:reports
labelCatalog.description: Management pack, weekly report, evidence health, and redaction-safe export.

labelCatalog.name: area:ci-release
labelCatalog.description: GitHub Actions, status checks, artifacts, release gate, and branch protection.

labelCatalog.name: owner:platform
labelCatalog.description: Repository shell, workflows, setup scripts, branch protection, and release evidence.

labelCatalog.name: owner:backend
labelCatalog.description: API app, route groups, services, validators, and contract tests.

labelCatalog.name: owner:security
labelCatalog.description: Auth, tenant, access, redaction, error envelope, and denial proof.

labelCatalog.name: owner:database
labelCatalog.description: Migrations, seeds, restore, parity checks, and data contracts.

labelCatalog.name: owner:migration
labelCatalog.description: Workbook import, staging batches, quarantine, and reconciliation.

labelCatalog.name: owner:billing
labelCatalog.description: Billing package, webhooks, invoices, seats, and access lock.

labelCatalog.name: owner:qa
labelCatalog.description: Smoke tests, fixtures, evidence artifacts, and release gates.

labelCatalog.name: proof:contract
labelCatalog.description: Endpoint contract or payload test evidence is required before review.

labelCatalog.name: proof:redaction
labelCatalog.description: Operational users cannot receive commercial or billing fields.

labelCatalog.name: proof:migration
labelCatalog.description: Migration, seed, restore, rollback, and count parity proof required.

labelCatalog.name: proof:billing
labelCatalog.description: Test-mode billing event, webhook, invoice, and seat-sync proof required.

labelCatalog.name: proof:audit
labelCatalog.description: Allowed and denied actions emit request-id-linked audit events.

labelCatalog.name: proof:smoke
labelCatalog.description: Staging or local smoke artifact is required for release movement.

labelCatalog.name: status:ready-for-dev
labelCatalog.description: Issue has owner, files, acceptance checks, and proof commands.

labelCatalog.name: status:needs-evidence
labelCatalog.description: Issue cannot merge until artifact or proof command output is attached.

labelCatalog.name: status:blocked
labelCatalog.description: Blocked by missing repo setup, secrets, workflow names, or upstream issue.

milestoneCatalog.title: M0 Repo shell
milestoneCatalog.description: Root files, workspace, env examples, docs, owners, and PR proof.

milestoneCatalog.title: M1 API and privacy core
milestoneCatalog.description: API boot, request id, error envelope, tenant scope, access decision, and route registry.

milestoneCatalog.title: M2 Data and fixtures
milestoneCatalog.description: Migrations, seed runner, fixtures, import dry-run, restore, and parity checks.

milestoneCatalog.title: M3 Workflow proof
milestoneCatalog.description: CI, security audit, migration restore, billing test mode, import dry run, and release gate workflows.

milestoneCatalog.title: M4 Staging alpha gate
milestoneCatalog.description: Smoke test, branch protection, owner signoff, and first release decision.

milestoneCatalog.title: Pilot hardening
milestoneCatalog.description: Fix staging smoke findings, support pilot feedback, and close release blockers.

milestoneCatalog.title: First customer readiness
milestoneCatalog.description: Prepare onboarding, billing test handoff, import rehearsal, support path, and go/no-go memo.

issueRoutingRules: priority:p0 goes to M0-M1 first and blocks feature depth.
type:foundation goes to M0 Repo shell and Platform Owner.
type:security goes to M1 API and privacy core and Security Owner.
type:data goes to M2 Data and fixtures and Database Owner.
type:import goes to M2 Data and fixtures and Migration Owner.
type:billing goes to M2 Data and fixtures and Billing Owner.
type:ci goes to M3-M4 workflow proof and Platform Owner.
proof:smoke goes to M4 Staging alpha gate and QA Owner.
importSteps: Dry-run label names for duplicates, spelling, colors, descriptions, and group prefixes.
Create labels with stable colors and descriptions.
Create milestones before issues are opened.
Create board columns from Backlog through Done.
Open data and fixture issues after P0 issue IDs exist.
Attach proof expectations to issue bodies.
Freeze taxonomy changes after first sprint starts unless admin approves.

qualityGates: No duplicate labels with different color or meaning.
Milestones must exist before issues are opened.
Every P0 issue must carry owner labels or explicit owner text.
Security, data, billing, audit, and staging issues need proof labels.
Board column names should not drift during sprint-zero import.
Foundation, API shell, privacy, tenant access, and audit issues open before billing or reports.
Required status checks from v119 should match issue proof labels.
After import, label or milestone changes need admin review and release-note mention.
acceptanceChecks: Label catalog complete across type, priority, area, owner, proof, and status groups.
Milestone catalog complete from repo shell through first customer readiness.
Board flow complete from backlog to release evidence.
Routing rules prevent issues from landing in the wrong milestone.
Command preview proves the catalog can be created with GitHub CLI.
Generated backend issues can inherit clean labels and milestones.
Quality gates protect naming, sequencing, proof, and taxonomy freeze.
v123 can validate starter files, scripts, workflows, branch protection, and release evidence before coding depth.
